context: A mom and son chat about music class
purpose: Teach: 伴奏/ダンサー/路面/アルファベット/質量/だらだら/燃費/ツーリング

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、合唱で、お友達の伴奏、ぼく、聞き惚れたよ。
lines.en: Mom, during chorus today — I heard my friend playing the accompaniment and I just got completely mesmerized.
lines.style: Bright, excited opening. Eager to share something that moved him. Soft wonder on 'mesmerized' — the memory of the feeling genuinely catches him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。テレビのダンサーさん、すごく上手だったね、昨日。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. That TV dancer yesterday was really impressive, wasn't she?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgement but slightly distracted — not quite following the same thread. A gentle redirect, the way a parent gently steers. Soft, present tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 雨の日、路面、滑るから、走らないでね、翔くん。
lines.en: On rainy days the pavement gets slippery, so you won't run, okay Sho?
lines.style: Careful, practical instruction wrapped in gentleness. Not commanding — more of a quiet insistence. The tone of someone who knows the world has small dangers.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お母さんと、アルファベット、お歌で、覚えようね。
lines.en: Yes. Let's learn the alphabet with Mom through a song, okay?
lines.style: Bright, encouraging, genuinely enjoying the idea. Light and playful invitation — not teaching-at, but inviting-in. A little hum of warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんが、質量って言葉、教えてくれたよ、難しい。
lines.en: Grandpa taught me the word 'mass' today and it's really hard to understand.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly uncertain tone. A little struggle in the voice — not complaint, but genuine puzzlement. Trusting that the weight of the word matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 休みの日、だらだら、寝てばかりじゃ、ダメよ、翔くん。
lines.en: You can't just laze around sleeping all day on your days off, Sho. That's not okay.
lines.style: Firm but not unkind. The voice of someone drawing a boundary gently but clearly. No softness here — a quiet insistence on doing rather than drifting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、車の燃費、自慢してたよ、ママ、最近。
lines.en: Your dad's been bragging about his car's fuel efficiency lately, Mom.
lines.style: Amused observation, slightly conspiratorial. The child noticing something funny about the adults around him. Quick, light delivery — sharing a small private moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんと、ツーリング、お父さん、行きたがってたわよ、今度。
lines.en: Dad's been wanting to go touring with Grandpa soon.
lines.style: Soft, gentle closing observation. The tone of someone relaying something he overheard without much weight behind it. A small, tender note — almost trailing away.
